business_problem: Telefónica needed to simplify complex processes, reduce repetitive non-value-added work, unify data, accelerate decision-making, improve customer communications, and operate network and service functions more efficiently across markets.
solution_summary: Telefónica describes a group-wide, in-house AI automation program that combines artificial intelligence, big data, advanced analytics, and cloud foundations to streamline business and network operations. Internal operational, network, and customer-service data is centralized and unified in big data and cloud environments, where AI and analytics are used to generate insights, detect patterns, prioritize actions, and support faster decisions. The outputs are served into customer-facing workflows through virtual agents, chatbots, virtual assistants, and email automation that handle enquiries, analyze calls, generate responses, and send proactive service explanations in customer-friendly language. For network operations, Telefónica says its Autonomous Network Journey (ANJ), aligned with TM Forum, applies AI and network automation across hundreds of production use cases so networks can increasingly self-configure, self-optimize, and self-heal while supporting scalability, resilience, and faster service delivery.
